meaning:
1) to be abundant (meaning probable)
1a) (Polel) to give abundance to
1b) (Hiphil) to overflow

elsewhere.note: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.
The threshing floors will be full of wheat, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
